summary: The Form 8-K filed by Ennis, Inc. reports Item 5.07—submission of matters to a shareholder vote at its 2026 Annual Meeting held July 16, 2026. Director Michael D. Magill did not receive a majority of votes cast in an uncontested election; he tendered his resignation, but the Board, after the Nominating and Governance Committee's recommendation, rejected it and he continues as director. All other management nominees were elected. Routine shareholder votes approved accounting firm and advisory executive compensation. This is a standard post-meeting filing with no special-situation event—no acquisition, activist campaign, tender offer, or other transformational action. The director resignation rejection is an internal governance matter, not a special situation.
